business_summary: BRBI BR Partners S.A., through its subsidiaries, operates as an investment bank that provides investment banking, capital market, treasury sales and structuring, investment, and wealth management services in Brazil. The company offers financial and strategic advisory services for mergers and acquisitions, capital markets and solutions, boards and shareholders, Pre-IPO, and privatizations. It also originates, structures, and distributes real estate receivables certificates, structured real estate receivables certificates, agribusiness receivables certificates, real estate investment funds, investment funds in agro-industrial production chains, credit rights investment funds, bank credit notes, and debentures. In addition, the company offers multi-product platform across foreign exchange, interest rates, commodities, and fixed income markets; derivative products comprising futures, swaps, forwards, and options; foreign exchange consisting of spot transactions and forward settlements; asset and liability management; fixed income, which include funding products, as well as trading in the secondary market for government bonds, debentures, and securitizations; and bank guarantees. Further, it manages the wealth of high-net-worth families; and makes minority investments in small and medium-sized companies through privately negotiated deals and structure vehicles. The company was formerly known as BR Advisory Partners Participações S.A. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil.
business_summary_ko: BRBI BR Partners S.A.는 자회사를 통해 브라질에서 투자 은행, 자본 시장, 국채 판매 및 구조화, 투자 및 자산 관리 서비스를 제공하는 투자 은행으로 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 인수 및 합병, 자본 시장 및 솔루션, 이사회 및 주주, Pre-IPO 및 민영화를 위한 금융 및 전략 자문 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 부동산 채권 증서, 구조화된 부동산 채권 증서, 농업 기업 채권 증서, 부동산 투자 자금, 농업 산업 생산 체인의 투자 자금, 신용권 투자 자금, 은행 신용권 및 사채를 생성, 구성 및 배포합니다. 또한 회사는 외환, 금리, 상품 및 채권 시장 전반에 걸쳐 다중 상품 플랫폼을 제공합니다. 선물, 스왑, 선도 및 옵션으로 구성된 파생 상품; 현물거래와 선물결제로 이루어진 외환, 자산 및 부채 관리; 자금 조달 상품과 국채, 사채 및 증권화에 대한 2차 시장 거래를 포함하는 고정 수입; 그리고 은행 보증. 푸르트
